modules.name: Bulgaria
modules.description: Harmonises one melody the way Bulgarian village choirs do: a drone and up to seven more voices that sit a deliberately mistuned second from the lead. Rub set in cents or as a beat rate in Hz, village tunings, slides, throat shakes and the phrase-end whoop. Pitch, gate and push CV out; makes no sound itself.

modules.name: Horo
modules.description: Clock and accent sequencer for Bulgarian uneven dance metres. Feed it a fast clock, pick ruchenitsa, daichovo, kopanitsa, buchimish or your own grouping of 2s and 3s; get beat and long-beat gates, bar and phrase triggers, an accent CV, and a pulse clock whose long beats can be stretched. The phrase trigger is made for Bulgaria's PHRASE input.
